name: Apply Coupons on Product Pages – For WooCommerce
author: RelyWP

sections.description:
A simple plugin to allow your customers to apply coupons on product pages, and see the discounted price immediately.

All you need to do is install the plugin, and the apply coupon field will then appear on all your product pages.

When the customer enters a coupon code, it will automatically update the prices shown on the product pages, showing both the original price, and the sale price.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/coupons-on-products-woo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
